subject: SCIM/SAML provisioning & session retention — gap analysis and artifact delivery
messages:
From: Sam Locke <sam.locke@novector.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@novector.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:07:00Z
Subject: SCIM delta logs + SAML session retention details

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As part of our SIG review I need the following artifacts to close the provisioning and session controls section:

- Recent SCIM delta export (sample of add/modify/deactivate events for the last 30 days)
- SAML session retention policy and example assertion timestamps showing session start/expiry
- RBAC snapshot (roles + member lists) as of 2026-11-01
- A short runbook describing how you handle SCIM failures and reconciliation steps

Can you confirm whether we can get these by EOD Friday 12/4? If there are any items you can’t share directly, point me to an internal summary or redacted sample and we’ll accept that.

Also, one ask from compliance: include an explanation of where service accounts live and whether they are included in SCIM or provisioned separately.

Appreciate it — we’re aiming to complete our SIG assessment next week.

Best,
Sam
Security Operations
Novector Health
[Attachment: SOC2_SIG_Template.docx]

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Locke <sam.locke@novector.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T18:25:00Z
Subject: Re: SCIM delta logs + SAML session retention details

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted artifacts and a runbook draft. Proposed plan:

1) Send a redacted SCIM delta CSV (sample window: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30) — we’ll remove any PII and internal IDs.
2) Provide an SAML session_retention_matrix.xlsx showing configured session lifetimes by application and example assertion timestamps (sanitized).
3) Attach RBAC snapshot JSON as of 2026-11-01 with role names and obfuscated user IDs.
4) Attach runbook_scim_provisioning_v0.3.pdf — includes reconciliation steps, retry windows, and escalation contacts.

Quick Q: service accounts — most are managed outside SCIM (service account registry + Vault). We’ll include a short note in the runbook and a sampled CSV of service account owners.

We aim to drop the bundle to a shared drive link by Friday morning (12/4). If you need anything earlier or need us to perform a short walkthrough, tell me and we’ll set up a 30m session.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_scim_provisioning_v0.3.pdf]

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: SCIM delta logs + SAML session retention details

Looping in Marissa for RBAC extraction — Marissa, can you confirm export fields and obfuscation approach? We want: role_id, role_name, member_count, member_type (user/service), and member_identifier (hashed).

Priyom — can you generate the SCIM delta sample (CSV) limited to user lifecycle events and include the delta_reason column? Keep window to 11/01–11/30. Mark rows that reference service accounts so we can produce the separate registry sample.

Notes from a quick review of the runbook draft: make explicit the reconciliation job schedule (cron expression) and include the point where we auto-disable accounts after three failed syncs. Also add a short blurb about KV cache TTL and how it affects deprovisioning latency.

I’ll put a checklist in the drive folder for the external reviewer.

—Irene
Sr. Engineering Program Manager
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 18:25 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted artifacts and a runbook draft. Proposed plan:
> ...

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Locke <sam.locke@novector.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@novector.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: SCIM delta logs + SAML session retention details

Sam — thanks for the patience. We’ve uploaded the requested artifacts to a protected folder and included a short walkthrough PDF. Summary of deliverables attached below and shared via link: https://drive.redwoodinc.com/s/SCIM-Delta-Report-2026-11 (read-only, expires 2027-01-04).

Deliverables (redacted samples):
- redwood_scim_delta_sample.csv — SCIM events (11/01–11/30), event_type, timestamp, delta_reason, target_type (user/service) [Attachment stub]
- session_retention_matrix.xlsx — configured SAML session lifetimes by app and example assertion times (sanitized) [Attachment stub]
- rbac_snapshot_2026-11-01.json — role roster with hashed identifiers and member_type flags [Attachment stub]
- runbook_scim_provisioning_v0.3.pdf — reconciliation flow, cron schedule, failure thresholds, escalation matrix [Attachment stub]
- service_account_registry_sample.csv — sample of service accounts and owners (no secrets)

Notes:
- Service accounts are not provisioned through customer-facing SCIM — they live in our internal registry and are injected into applications at deployment time. We documented the owner and rotation cadence in the runbook.
- We applied consistent hashing to identifiers and redacted email addresses per Novector’s SIG guidance.
- If you require full logs (unredacted) we’ll need an NDA amendment / scoping call; let us know.

Attachments: runbook_scim_provisioning_v0.3.pdf, redwood_scim_delta_sample.csv, session_retention_matrix.xlsx, rbac_snapshot_2026-11-01.json

Happy to walk through the runbook — I can do 12/04 16:00–16:30 PT if that suits your team.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: runbook_scim_provisioning_v0.3.pdf]
